proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Lars sent us a photo of every wall after tear-off. Two spots under the kitchen window were soft, and they replaced the sheathing before any wrap went on. The quote already listed a price per sheet, so there was no surprise.
reviews.name: Ingrid N.

reviews.text: June hail took out the whole west side of our rambler. They photographed each wall with a chalk circle on every dent, which our adjuster used as is. The new panels match the other three sides.
reviews.name: Craig O.

reviews.text: We went with insulated siding on our 1958 house. The living room is noticeably quieter on the street side and the walls look straight even in January.
reviews.name: Beth A.

reviews.text: They wrapped our fascia and put vented soffit all the way around. Last winter was the first one in years without a row of icicles hanging off the front of the house.
reviews.name: Tom R.

reviews.text: Fiber cement on a 1920s bungalow. They kept the look of the old wide window trim and painted the boards before install. Neighbors keep asking if it is wood.
reviews.name: Nora L.

reviews.text: The crew was on site nine working days, one longer than planned because of rain. They told us each evening which side would be done next and swept for nails twice a day.
reviews.name: Gary P.

proof.guarantee: If a course we set comes loose or water gets behind our flashing, we come back and fix it at no charge.
